verses.geez: ወእደ፡ ተናገረ፡ ኢዮብ፡ ተሠጥወ፡ ወይቤ።
verses.translation: And Job answered and said,

translations.lxx: And Job answered and said,
translations.kjv: And Job answered and said,
translations.ron: Atunci Iov a răspuns şi a zis:
translations.grk: Ὑπολαβὼν δὲ Ἰὼβ, λέγει,

verses.geez: አንትሙኒ፡ ሰብእ፡ አንትሙ፡ ወበኀቤክሙኑ፡ ዳዕሙ፡ ጠሠልጠት፡ ጥበብ።
verses.translation: So then ye alone are men, and wisdom shall die with you?

translations.lxx: So then ye alone are men, and wisdom shall die with you?
translations.kjv: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
translations.ron: "Cu adevărat numai voi sunteţi înţelepţi şi înţelepciunea va muri o dată cu voi.
translations.grk: Εἶτα ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἄνθρωποι, ἢ μεθʼ ὑμῶν τελευτήσει σοφία;

verses.geez: ወአነሂ፡ ብየ፡ ልብ፡ ከማክሙ፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ከመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ሰሐቀ፡ ለቢጹ፡ ይከውን፡ ወሰሐቀ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ንጹሕ።
verses.translation: But I also have a heart as well as you.

translations.lxx: But I also have a heart as well as you.
translations.kjv: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
translations.ron: Dar şi eu am minte ca voi şi nu sunt mai prejos decât voi şi cine nu cunoaşte lucrurile pe care mi le-aţi spus?
translations.grk: Κᾀμοὶ μὲν καρδία καθʼ ὑμᾶς ἐστι.

verses.geez: ወብእሲ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወንጹሕ፡ ስላቀ፡ ኮነ፡ በዕድሜ፡ መዋዕሊሁ።
verses.translation: For a righteous and blameless man has become a subject for mockery.

translations.lxx: For a righteous and blameless man has become a subject for mockery.
translations.kjv: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
translations.ron: Eu am ajuns pricină de batjocură pentru prietenul meu, eu care chem pe Dumnezeu şi căruia El răspunde: cel drept, cel fără vină e pricină de râs.
translations.grk: Δίκαιος γὰρ ἀνὴρ καὶ ἄμεμπτος ἐγεννήθη εἰς χλεύασμα·

verses.geez: ወአጽንሕዎ፡ ያርስሕዎ፡ ባዕዳን፡ ወከመ፡ ያውድቁ፡ ቤተ፡ ኃጥአን።
verses.translation: For it had been ordained that he should fall under others at the appointed time, and that his houses should be spoiled by transgressors: let not however any one trust that, being evil, he shall be held guiltless,

translations.lxx: For it had been ordained that he should fall under others at the appointed time, and that his houses should be spoiled by transgressors: let not however any one trust that, being evil, he shall be held guiltless,
translations.kjv: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
translations.ron: Să dispreţuim nenorocirea (gândesc cei fericiţi); încă o lovitură celor ce se poticnesc.
translations.grk: Εἰς χρόνον γὰρ τακτὸν ἡτοίμαστο πεσεῖν ὑπὸ ἄλλων, οἴκους τε αὐτοῦ ἐκπορθεῖσθαι ὑπὸ ἀνόμων·

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ እኩያን፡ እለ፡ ያምፅዕዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ይብሉ፡ ኄራን፡ ንሕነ፡ አኮኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘየሐትቶሙ።
verses.translation: even as many as provoke the Lord, as if there were indeed to be no inquisition made of them.

translations.lxx: even as many as provoke the Lord, as if there were indeed to be no inquisition made of them.
translations.kjv: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.
translations.ron: Foarte liniştite stau şi sunt corturile jefuitorilor şi cei ce mânie pe Dumnezeu sunt plini de încredere, ca unii care au făcut din pumnul lor un dumnezeu.
translations.grk: οὐ μὴν δὲ ἀλλὰ μηδεὶς πεποιθέτω πονηρὸς ὢν ἀθῶος ἔσεσθαι, ὅσοι παροργίζουσι τὸν Κύριον, ὡς οὐχὶ καὶ ἔτασις αὐτῶν ἔσται.

verses.geez: ተሰአሎሙ፡ ለእንስሳሂ፡ ለእመ፡ ይነግሩከ፡ ወለዕዋፈ፡ ሰማይኒ፡ ለእመ፡ ያየድሁከ።
verses.translation: But ask now the beasts, if they may speak to thee; and the birds of the air, if they may declare to thee.

translations.lxx: But ask now the beasts, if they may speak to thee; and the birds of the air, if they may declare to thee.
translations.kjv: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
translations.ron: Dar ia întreabă dobitoacele şi te vor învăţa, şi păsările cerului, şi te vor lămuri;
translations.grk: Ἀλλὰ δὴ ἐρώτησον τετράποδα ἐάν σοι εἴπωσι, πετεινὰ δὲ οὐρανοῦ ἐάν σοι ἀπαγγείλωσιν.

verses.geez: ወተናገራ፡ ለምድር፡ ለአመ፡ ትፌክር፡ ለከ፡ ወለእመ፡ ይነግሩከ፡ ዓሣተ፡ ባሕር።
verses.translation: Tell the earth, if it may speak to thee: and the fishes of the sea shall explain to thee.

translations.lxx: Tell the earth, if it may speak to thee: and the fishes of the sea shall explain to thee.
translations.kjv: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
translations.ron: Sau vorbeşte cu pământul, şi-ţi va da învăţătură şi peştii mării îţi vor istorisi cu de-amănuntul.
translations.grk: Ἐκδιήγησαι γῇ, ἐάν σοι φράσῃ, καὶ ἐξηγήσονταί σοι οἱ ἰχθύες τῆς θαλάσσης.

verses.geez: መኑ፡ የአምር፡ ዘንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ እደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ገብረ።
verses.translation: Who then has not known in all these things, that the hand of the Lord has made them?

translations.lxx: Who then has not known in all these things, that the hand of the Lord has made them?
translations.kjv: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
translations.ron: Cine nu cunoaşte din toate acestea că mâna Domnului a făcut aceste lucruri?
translations.grk: Τίς οὖν οὐκ ἔγνω ἐν πᾶσι τούτοις, ὅτι χεὶρ Κυρίου ἐποίησε ταῦτα;

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕያው፡ ወመንፈሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ።
verses.translation: Whereas the life of all living things is in his hand, and the breath of every man.

translations.lxx: Whereas the life of all living things is in his hand, and the breath of every man.
translations.kjv: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
translations.ron: În mâna Lui El ţine viaţa a tot ce trăieşte şi suflarea întregii omeniri.
translations.grk: Εἰ μὴ ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ψυχὴ πάντων ζώντων, καὶ πνεῦμα παντὸς ἀνθρώπου.

verses.geez: እኮኑ፡ ዕዝን፡ ይፈልጥ፡ ነገረ፡ ወጕርዔሂ፡ ይጥዕም፡ እክለ።
verses.translation: For the ear tries words, and the palate tastes meats.

translations.lxx: For the ear tries words, and the palate tastes meats.
translations.kjv: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
translations.ron: Urechea nu deosebeşte ea cuvintele tot aşa, precum cerul gurii deosebeşte mâncarea?
translations.grk: Οὖς μὲν γὰρ ῥήματα διακρίνει, λάρυγξ δὲ σῖτα γεύεται.

verses.geez: በብዝኀ፡ ዓመታትኑ፡ ትትረከብ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወበብዝኀ፡ ንብ፡ ረትኑ፡ ትምህርት።
verses.translation: In length of time is wisdom, and in long life knowledge.

translations.lxx: In length of time is wisdom, and in long life knowledge.
translations.kjv: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
translations.ron: Oare nu la bătrâni sălăşluieşte înţelepciunea şi priceperea nu merge mână în mână cu vârsta înaintată?
translations.grk: Ἐν πολλῷ χρόνῳ σοφία, ἐν δὲ πολλῷ βίῳ ἐπιστήμη.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኵሉ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወኃይል፡ ወሎቱ፡ ምክር፡ ወአእምሮ።
verses.translation: With him are wisdom and power, with him counsel and understanding.

translations.lxx: With him are wisdom and power, with him counsel and understanding.
translations.kjv: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
translations.ron: La Dumnezeu se află înţelepciunea şi puterea; sfatul şi pătrunderea sunt ale Lui.
translations.grk: Παρʼ αὐτῷ σοφία καὶ δύναμις, αὐτῷ βουλὴ καὶ σύνεσις.

verses.geez: ወለእመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ነሠተ፡ መኑ፡ የሐንጽ፡ ወለእመ፡ ዓፀወ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሰብእ፡ መኑ፡ ያርኁ፡፡ 15፡ እመ፡ ከልአ፡ እምሰማይ፡ ዝናመ፡ ያየብሳ፡ ለምድር፡ ወለእመ፡ ኃደጋ፡ ትማስን፡ ወትትገፈታዕ።
verses.translation: If he should cast down, who will build up? if he should shut up against men, who shall open?

translations.lxx: If he should cast down, who will build up? if he should shut up against men, who shall open?
translations.kjv: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
translations.ron: Ceea ce dărâmă El, nimeni nu mai zideşte la loc şi pe cine-l închide, nimeni nu poate să-l mai deschidă.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν καταβάλῃ, τίς οἰκοδομήσει; ἐὰν κλείσῃ κατʼ ἀνθρώπων, τίς ἀνοίξει;

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እማኀቤ፡ ኃይል፡ ወጽንዕ፡ ወዘዚአሁ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወምክር።
verses.translation: With him are strength and power: he has knowledge and understanding.

translations.lxx: With him are strength and power: he has knowledge and understanding.
translations.kjv: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
translations.ron: Tăria şi înţelepciunea sunt la El. El este stăpân şi peste rătăcit şi peste cel ce-l face să rătăcească.
translations.grk: Παρʼ αὐτῷ κράτος καὶ ἰσχὺς, αὐτῷ ἐπιστήμη καὶ σύνεσις.

verses.geez: ወይሬስዮሙ፡ ለመካርያን፡ ወይፄወዉ፡ ወይወስድዎሙ፡ ለመኳንንተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: He leads counsellors away captive, and maddens the judges of the earth.

translations.lxx: He leads counsellors away captive, and maddens the judges of the earth.
translations.kjv: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
translations.ron: El goneşte pe sfetnici în picioarele goale şi pe judecători îi aruncă pradă nebuniei.
translations.grk: Διάγων βουλευτὰς αἰχμαλώτους, κριτὰς δὲ γῆς ἐξέστησε.

verses.geez: ወያነብሮሙ፡ ለነገሥት፡ ዲበ፡ መናብርት፡ ወያቀንቶሙ፡ ቅናተ፡ ዘኃይል፡ ውስተ፡ ሐቌሆሙ።
verses.translation: He seats kings upon thrones, and girds their loins with a girdle.

translations.lxx: He seats kings upon thrones, and girds their loins with a girdle.
translations.kjv: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
translations.ron: El destramă puterea împăraţilor şi pune cingătoare de frânghie în jurul coapselor lor.
translations.grk: Καθιζάνων βασιλεῖς ἐπὶ θρόνους, καὶ περιεδησε ζώνῃ ὀσφύας αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወይፌንዎሙ፡ ለማርያን፡ ይሄወዉ፡ ወይገፈትዖሙ፡ ለኃያላነ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: He sends away priests into captivity, and overthrows the mighty ones of the earth.

translations.lxx: He sends away priests into captivity, and overthrows the mighty ones of the earth.
translations.kjv: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
translations.ron: El goneşte pe preoţi în picioarele goale şi dă peste cap pe cei puternici.
translations.grk: Ἐξαποστέλλων ἱερεῖς αἰχμαλώτους, δυνάστας δὲ γῆς κατέστρεψε.

verses.geez: ወይመይጥ፡ ከናፍሪሆሙ፡ ለመሃይምናን፡ ወየአምር፡ ምክሮሙ፡ ለሊቃውንት።
verses.translation: He changes the lips of the trusty, and he knows the understanding of the elders.

translations.lxx: He changes the lips of the trusty, and he knows the understanding of the elders.
translations.kjv: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
translations.ron: El taie vorba celor meşteri la cuvânt şi ia mintea celor bătrâni.
translations.grk: Διαλλάσσων χείλη πιστῶν, σύνεσιν δὲ πρεσβυτέρων ἔγνω.

verses.geez: ወያመጽአ፡ ሎሙ፡ ኃሣረ፡ ለመላእክት፡ ወይሣሃሎሙ፡ ለትሑታን።
verses.translation: He pours dishonour upon princes, and heals the lowly.

translations.lxx: He pours dishonour upon princes, and heals the lowly.
translations.kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
translations.ron: El face de ocară pe cei mari şi slăbeşte încingătoarea celor voinici.
translations.grk: Ἐκχέων ἀτιμίαν ἐπʼ ἄρχοντας, ταπεινοὺς δὲ ἰάσατο.

verses.geez: ወይከሥት፡ ዕሙቃተ፡ እምጽልመት፡ ወያወዕኦሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ብርሃነ፡ እምጽልመት፡ ወጽላሎተ፡ ሞት።
verses.translation: Revealing deep things out of darkness: and he has brought into light the shadow of death.

translations.lxx: Revealing deep things out of darkness: and he has brought into light the shadow of death.
translations.kjv: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
translations.ron: El scoate din întuneric lucrurile ascunse şi aduce la lumină ceea ce era acoperit de umbră.
translations.grk: Ἀνακαλύπτων βαθέα ἐκ σκότους, ἐξήγαγε δὲ εἰς φῶς σκιὰν θανάτου.

verses.geez: ወየሀውኮሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ ወይትኀጐሉ፡ ወይሠርዖሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ ወይመርሖሙ።
verses.translation: Causing the nations to wander, and destroying them: overthrowing the nations, and leading them away.

translations.lxx: Causing the nations to wander, and destroying them: overthrowing the nations, and leading them away.
translations.kjv: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
translations.ron: El sporeşte neamurile şi apoi le pierde, El le lasă să se întindă şi apoi le strâmtorează.
translations.grk: Πλανῶν ἔθνη καὶ ἀπολλύων αὐτὰ, καταστρωννύων ἔθνη καὶ καθοδηγῶν αὐτά.

verses.geez: ወይመይጥ፡ ምክሮሙ፡ ለመላእክተ፡ ምድር፡ ወያዔይ፡ ሎሙ፡ ፍኖተ፡ እንተ፡ ኢያእመሩ።
verses.translation: Perplexing the minds of the princes of the earth: and he causes them to wander in a way they have not known, saying,

translations.lxx: Perplexing the minds of the princes of the earth: and he causes them to wander in a way they have not known, saying,
translations.kjv: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
translations.ron: El scoate din minţi pe căpeteniile popoarelor şi îi lasă să rătăcească în singurătăţi fără cărări.
translations.grk: Διαλλάσσων καρδίας ἀρχόντων γῆς· ἐπλάνησε δὲ αὐτοὺς ἐν ὁδῷ ᾗ οὐκ ᾔδεισαν.
